facility.name: Little Buffalos
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 832 N AVE E, CROSS PLAINS, TX, 76443

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: A caregiver that does not have valid CPR or Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing was in the pre-k classroom alone supervising children. This was corrected at inspection when another caregiver with valid CPR stepped into the classroom bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The small outdoor play area contains goat head stickers and tall grass.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation had not conducted a fire drill since  October 30, 2025. The operation conducted a fire drill during the inspection and documented it, bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A water hose was unwound in the walk way to the outdoor area causing a possible tripping hazard. This was corrected at inspection when the water hose was removed bringing the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: 2 caregivers were lacking training in required topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two caregiver files reviewed did not have current first aid and CPR certifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation has a daily and monthly checklist however they are not utlizing this and keeping documentation of this.  The last checlist for buildiing, grounds and playground was completed in October 2023.     This was corrected at inpection when Director completed a thorough walk through of the operation and documented this using the building and grounds checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Separate from Older Children: When I arrived two classes were combined together waking up from naptime. The youngest child was 15 months old and the oldest child was 5 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.4203)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation was utilizing a daily grounds checklist but has not utilized this since July 12, 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 7-month-old infant was was observed sleeping in  a crib with a blanket and intant toys.  This was corrected when the blanket and toys were removed during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The toilets had dried urine around the base, there was no toilet paper in the bathrooms, the sinks were dirty.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The daily sign in sheets shows 5 children in the toddler group, and 7 on the preschool class. There were only a total of 11 children in care. The sign in sheets for the 13th were missing for the preschool class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The operation did not have a policy in place that all caregivers knew and were following for taking children outside based on weather conditions. Therefore, children were not being provided proper outdoor play opportunities as shown on the activity plans.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Placement of Groups - Not Exceed Room Capacity: During this investigation, it was determined that the operation is routinely exceeding the room capacity of 7 children. This was corrected during inspection dated 4-6-23, when the operation was advised of the rules regarding room capacity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Placement of Groups - Not Exceed Room Capacity (26 TAC §746.1505(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: A tv was on a shelf in a classroom and was not achcored.  This was fixed during the inspection when the tv was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: A caregiver did not have a high school diploma, GED or certificate of completion.  This was cited under 746.201(9).  The caregiver was sent home pending completion of this requirement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: During the investigation it was determined that the operation had a caregiver providing unsupervised care while the caregiver has provisional conditions attached to the background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: As a result of this investigation, it was determined the operation knowingly hired an employee as a caregiver who did not have a high school diploma or GED as required in 746.1107, and allowed the employee to perform caregiver duties with and without supervision of a qualified caregiver.     The operation created a high school diploma in the caregivers name to keep in the file in an attempt to satisfy standard 746.1107 pending the caregiver meeting standard 746.1107 at a later date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Based on records reviewed, staff's pre-service training  did not meet the requirements of mimimum standards. What training was provided, was presented by a person not qualified to present the training per 746.1317.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: Based on observations and interviews with staff, activity plans are not being followed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined that 2 school aged children, who are homeschooled are at the operation daily, and are allowed to be in the school age classroom unsupervised on a regular basis.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
